site-map.summary:
TARIH north-up master map. Sources: all three key plans, the sheet renders, and the city map on the sheets. The B key-plan compass points straight up. On C the north arrow is tilted about 10° counter-clockwise and on E about 15° counter-clockwise. That matches the city map, where Айтматова runs NNE–SSW and Улы Дала runs WNW–ESE, so the whole bigville grid is turned about 10–15° clockwise. "North side" below therefore really faces about NNE, "east" about ESE, and so on. All key plans are effectively north-up, and none of the three is rotated 90°.

BIG PICTURE: The plot is L-shaped. Улы Дала runs along the north and ул. Ч. Айтматова along the west. DARYN fills the northern band along Улы Дала, about 250–300 m deep. TARIH is the band directly south of DARYN, starting at Айтматова and running east. The boundary between them is an E–W 'Перспективная улица', a planned city street labelled on the C sheets. Across it to the north are DARYN F/G (near Айтматова) and DARYN M (opposite E, labelled 'Вид на перспективный проект ÜIA.DARYN M' on the E sheets). TARIH's north faces are therefore about 280–320 m south of Улы Дала, and Улы Дала is not visible from any TARIH office. South of TARIH there is a real multi-lane city street (no name on the sheets). It runs from Айтматова eastward past the ФМЛ (физмат лицей), which stands south of it (brochure p3, E render).

INSIDE TARIH: two rows of blocks separated by an E–W pedestrian 'Аллея'. It is a tree-lined boulevard starting at Айтматова: labelled north of B on the B sheets, south of E on the E sheets, and lit in the brochure.
- NORTH ROW (between the boundary street and the Аллея), west to east:
  - A (строится, no offices in this set) on the corner of Айтматова and the boundary street.
  - An internal driveway, about 20–30 m.
  - C (Бизнес, closed 10-section square, all 9 эт, about 95×95 m), about 130–250 m east of Айтматова.
  - The N–S 'Перспективная улица' between C and E (labelled on C's east and E's west). It runs from the boundary street south across the Аллея to the southern street.
  - E (Бизнес, 5 sections of 9 эт, about 70×75 m), about 280–350 m east of Айтматова. It is U-shaped: 4,5 along the north; 3 on the west; 2,1 along the south. The courtyard opens to the east.
  - East of E, a short driveway with parking, then perspective project F ('Вид на перспективный проект ÜIA.TARIH F').
- SOUTH ROW (between the Аллея and the southern city street):
  - B (Комфорт+), the SW block of the whole bigville. Section 4 (12 эт) sits on Айтматова between 5 (NW corner) and 3 (SW corner). Sections 5-6-7-8 and a corner piece run along the Аллея. Section 9 (12 эт) and 10 form the east side. Sections 3-2-1 run along the southern street, with a courtyard and parking entrance gap between 1 and 10. B is about 140 m E–W × 90 m N–S, directly south of A across the Аллея (about 25–35 m).
  - East of B, a green pedestrian passage with a footpath (about 25–35 m), then a neighbouring perspective block (brochure letter D).
  - C's south side faces the Аллея and, across it, perspective south-row plots.

DISCREPANCY: brochure p3 (from the DARYN brochure) letters the TARIH perspective blocks with F apparently south of E. The newer office sheets, printed 14.10.2026, and the E render put F EAST of E and north of the Аллея. I trusted the sheets.

- C sections 1, 6, 7, 9, 10: north-up.

site-map.traffic_ranking:
1) B west façade on ул. Айтматова (section 4, offices 16 and 17, plus corner sections 5 and 3). This is the only TARIH frontage on the arterial: through car traffic, public-transport pedestrians, and visibility from passing cars over the whole length. The NW corner (Айтматова × Аллея) adds the pedestrian stream entering the boulevard. The SW corner (Айтматова × southern street) adds the turn flow toward the ФМЛ лицей. Clear #1.
2) Corners of the two Перспективные streets: C's NE corner (section 3) and E's NW corner (section 4). They are seen from both the boundary street and the C|E street and sit at the main internal crossroads, where TARIH and DARYN M/G residents meet. Next come the Перспективная × Аллея corners: C's SE corner (section 6) and E's SW corner (section 2), which get car visibility plus the boulevard foot traffic.
3) B's south façade on the southern city street (sections 3-2-1-10). It is an existing multi-lane street from Айтматова to the ФМЛ, with school drop-off traffic, but its visibility falls off with distance from Айтматова. Section 10 (offices 2 and 1) is about 120–140 m east of Айтматова.
4) The rest of the TARIH/DARYN boundary street: C's north side (sections 1, 2) and E's north side (sections 4, 5). These are two-sided residential streets serving TARIH and the southern part of DARYN. There is moderate car flow and no view from Улы Дала, which is about 300 m away.
5) The N–S Перспективная улица between C and E: C's east (sections 4, 5) and E's west (section 3 offices 7–9, section 2 office 10). This is a local cluster street with good pedestrian flow from both blocks to the Аллея and the south street, but low through-traffic.
6) The Аллея frontages: B north (section 6 offices 11 and 12), C south (sections 7–9), E south (sections 1, 2). Pedestrian foot traffic is strong (the boulevard from Айтматова into the cluster) and good for cafés and services, but cars cannot see these units. B's Аллея frontage near Айтматова is the strongest of these, and E's, at the far east end, is the weakest.
7) Internal driveways and passages:
   - C west, toward A (offices 1–3)
   - B east green passage (section 9 offices 4 and 5, section 10 office 3)
   - the C NW courtyard-entrance corner
   These get residents and service traffic only.
8) E east, toward the empty F plot: weakest until F is built.
Closed courtyards are not retail frontage.

B.building_notes:
ÜIA.TARIH B (Комфорт+) is the SW block of the whole bigville. All four B key plans I checked (B-3, B-4, B-12, B-16) have the compass pointing straight up (С at the top). 'Аллея' is printed along the top of the key plan and 'ул. Ч.Айтматова' along the left edge. All four section plans on p1 (10, 9, 6, 4) are north-up, which matches the master map. The rotation evidence for each section:
- Section 10: 'Блокируется с 9 подъездом' is at the top of the plan, and 9 is north of 10 on the key plan.
- Section 9: 'Блокируется с 10 подъездом' is at the bottom.
- Section 6: 'Аллея' is at the top, 'Блокируется с 5 подъездом' on the left and 'Блокируется с 7 подъездом' on the right.
- Section 4: 'ул. Ч.Айтматова' is on the left, 'Блокируется с 5 подъездом' at the top and 'Блокируется с 3 подъездом' at the bottom.

The block is a closed perimeter:
- Section 4 (12 эт) sits on Айтматова, between 5 (NW corner) and 3 (SW corner).
- Sections 5-6-7-8 and an unnumbered NE corner piece run along the Аллея on the north.
- Section 9 (12 эт) forms the east side, under the corner piece.
- Section 10 (9 эт) is the SE corner. It is offset south of 9 and sticks out further west than 9.
- Sections 3-2-1 run along the southern city street. There is a courtyard/parking gap between 1 and 10.

What each outer side faces:
- W: ул. Айтматова. Labelled on the section 4 plan and on p2 of offices 16 and 17. This is the only TARIH arterial frontage, with a green strip and sidewalk to the carriageway.
- N: the tree-lined pedestrian Аллея, with TARIH A across it. Labelled 'Аллея' above the section 6 plan and on p2 of office 12.
- E (sections 9 and 10): a green strip, footpath and service passage, then a perspective neighbour block. There is no street label. In the render it is a green buffer with a path.
- S (sections 3-2-1-10): the multi-lane southern city street (render). It has no label on the sheets.
- Inner sides: the closed residents' courtyard. The residential lobbies have тамбур-шлюз doors into it: on the west of section 9, the east of section 4 and the south of section 6. The office walls facing the yard are blank.

Details shared by all six offices:
- Every office has its own street tambour (7.82 m² in sections 4 and 9; 6.67 m² in section 10; 5.67 m² in section 6).
- Every office has a С/у and a ПУИ.
- Ceiling h = 4.18 m. All windows are 'Тип 1', 1.81 m wide, with a 0.78 m sill and a 3.4 m opening.
- A 'РН 500x300' outlet sits next to every entrance door.

The p2 dimension strings put a '1,81м тип 1' mark on the entrance door opening as well as on each window. So each glazing_m below includes that door/витраж (windows + door).

The master map agrees with the sheets for these six offices. I found no discrepancy.

- N (sections 1-2-3): the TARIH/DARYN boundary 'Перспективная улица'. It is printed above the key plan and above the section 1 and section 2 plans ('Перспективная улица' on p1 and p2 of C-19, C-20 and C-22).
- E (sections 3-4-5-6): the N–S 'Перспективная улица' between C and E. It is printed to the right of the key plan and of the section 4, 5 and 6 plans.
- NE corner (section 3): the crossing of the two Перспективные streets.

- W (sections 9-10): faces the internal driveway toward A.
- NW: an open corner (no building between section 10 and section 1) toward the driveway and the boundary street. Section 1's west gable is a blank brick wall facing it.
Yard sides of all sections face the closed courtyard ('двор ЖК'). Residential Тамбур-шлюз doors on the yard side confirm this: section 5/4 on the west, section 2/1 on the south, section 6 at the inner NW corner.
Section types:
- Sections 4 and 5 (E side) have identical layouts. Each has one large office of about 113–115 m² in the north half (a front room on the street, a windowless back room on the yard side with С/у МГН, С/у and ПУИ, plus a small glazed sub-room south of the brick cross-wall). Each also has a small office of about 49.5 m² in the south half. The residential entrance (Тамбур 7,02) is on the east between them. Section 4 also has exterior steps along the façade in front of the sub-room window.

A larger office (about 95–97 m²) sits at the east end, with 4.2 m of street glazing and a windowless back room.
- Section 6 (SE corner): office 11 is on the north and office 10 on the SE corner, both with east tambours. Office 9 is in the SW part with south tambours. The residential entrance (Тамбур 7,21 with steps) is on the south.
Every office has its own С/у МГН + С/у + ПУИ, h=4.2 m, a 380 mm brick outer wall and type-1 floor-to-ceiling витражи (4.2 m). The vent shafts are marked 400x200 + 150x150.
None of the C offices is visible from ул. Айтматова (about 130–250 m away, behind TARIH A). Улы Дала is about 300 m north beyond DARYN.
